title: SSX Out of Bounds (Polish)
statusNote: Starts like the original with Polish menus (Nazwa Profilu, Menu Glowne: Tryb Kariery, Szybka Gra, Opcje) and reaches a race on the first track with the same key script.
notes: A fan translation of SSX Out of Bounds: the menus and texts are Polish, written without Polish diacritics. In the main menu Tryb Kariery is the career (Conquer The Mountain), Szybka Gra a single event, Pobij Rekord! shadow racing, Opcje the options and Wyjdz quits.
On the first start the game asks for a profile name (the digit keys type letters, the left soft key accepts) and a favourite rider.
In menus 5 selects and 7 goes back. In a race, tricks fill the boost meter and 5 spends it; after a fall, tap 5 to recover.
The keys can be changed in the game under Options > Key Mapping.
Multiplayer in the main menu does not work yet: tried with the original game, the joining player's search finds nobody. N-Gage Arena was Nokia's online service and cannot work.

multiplayer.statusNote: One player chooses Host, accepts the warning that the Bluetooth name will change and waits at "Waiting for players to join SSX game"; the other chooses Join and gets "Search Complete: None Found". The host puts the game's identifier in front of its Bluetooth name as characters the emulator removes, so the joiner probably does not recognise it. Tried with the original game.

controls.source: Same as SSX Out of Bounds; the translated key mapping screen (Opcje > Sterowanie) lists the same keys. This variant was checked up to its menus by hand and into a race with the same key script.

actions.5: Boost; grab 5; recover after a fall; select in menus

notes: Keyboard: arrows steer, Space or Z jumps (7), Enter or X boosts and selects (5), A and D punch (4 and 6), Escape pauses; the grabs stay on the digit row. Gamepad: A or X is 5, B or Y is 7, the shoulder buttons punch (4 and 6), the triggers are grabs 9 and 10, the right stick gives grabs 1 (left), 3 (right), 2 (up) and 8 (down), Start pauses, Back is the left soft key and pressing the left stick is 0 (respawn).
